review.body:
Blocking on PR metadata: the description no longer matches the head commit, so the in-depth review was not run.

- **Renovate datasource behaviour.** The description says the latest snapshot is "the day the `resolute-security` pocket last changed" and that this is what keeps it to at most one bump a day. The head commit is different. The `ubuntu-snapshot` transform pins the exact time on the InRelease `Date:` line (for example `20261121T095046Z`), and the daily `schedule` window in the package rule is what limits bumps.
- **Test plan describes an earlier revision.** The `apt-cache policy` check and the Renovate dry run both name `20261121T000000Z` (the dry run proposed `20261101T000000Z` → `20261121T000000Z`). The core image now pins `20261121T095046Z` with a different transform, so these results don't cover the code being merged. Re-run them against the current pin and transform, or drop those claims.
- **Open items in the body.** Two unchecked `- [ ]` items remain: the core-systemd smoke failure and "CI on both architectures". Close them with evidence or take them out of the description. CI reports its own status.

Update the title and description to match the head commit, then request a fresh review.
